page.layout: One page of names in a single column, set in groups separated by blank lines. Heading fragments at the top and in the upper right, cut off at the edge. Below it, short lines of page references and one italic line with a spaced-capitals line beneath it, all in the centre of the strip, with no margin notes.; One column of names in lines, starting under the running head at top left; page number at top right. page.notes: Printed letters are read from a scan of uneven clarity. "Iohan" and "Ioannes" are copied as J-forms per the consonant rule, and the long s in "Isebrants" is read as plain s. Doubtful: "Isebrants" (the letter could be long s or f). "Hind." may stand for Hindrick. The lines of the upper right heading are only partly visible. Only a narrow strip is visible, so the lines are short and fragmentary. Several lines are hard to read and may be incomplete. The number lines may belong to a contents or index list, but the strip does not show their wording. The leading digit of the year numbers at the left edge (38, 639, 640 and so on) is cut off, so the first digits of "38" and "640" are doubtful. The word "Starkenb." in the entries for 641 is underlined in the print; the underline is not transcribed. The head lines "um Princeps Awaicus," and "RNATOR." are fragments cut at the left edge of the scan.
